meta.title: RZ-Fiqh Database-First Engineering Execution Backlog
meta.planning_note: Wave is a dependency-sequencing bucket, not a calendar commitment. The knowledge workflow is PostgreSQL-backed and has no external file synchronization layer.

epics.name: Platform Foundations, Identity & Observability
epics.outcome: Baseline service, OIDC, RBAC tenant/scope, audit append-only, correlation ID, telemetry, dan health contract yang konsisten.
epics.exit_criteria: Web/API/worker lolos CI; login OIDC berfungsi; permission-denied tests lolos; setiap request memiliki trace_id; audit dan health tersedia.
epics.fr_ids: FR-EVAL-004, FR-KNW-006, FR-RAG-004, FR-SRC-001, FR-STU-003, FR-STU-006, FR-STU-007, FR-VAL-004

epics.name: Source Registry & Immutable Evidence
epics.outcome: Setiap sumber memiliki stable identity/revision, original file content-addressed, rights/access tercatat, dan deprecation tidak merusak trace lama.
epics.exit_criteria: Source dapat dibuat, di-upload, dibuka, direvisi, dan dideprecate; silent overwrite ditolak; trace lama tetap resolve.

epics.name: Pluggable Ingestion, Traceability & OCR
epics.outcome: Seluruh format Must memakai processor contract yang sama, menghasilkan manifest, page/section/span stabil, serta OCR yang dapat dikoreksi tanpa menghapus output awal.
epics.exit_criteria: Fixture semua format menghasilkan manifest; passage membuka lokasi tepat; raw dan corrected OCR dapat dibandingkan.

epics.name: Database Knowledge Model & Validation
epics.outcome: Typed PostgreSQL knowledge records, immutable concept revisions, provenance/verification, and typed links are validated without a second canonical representation.
epics.exit_criteria: Concept revisions are immutable; all nine types validate; broken links block publication; provenance and source-span links are auditable.

epics.name: Knowledge Studio, Review & Database Releases
epics.outcome: Editors and reviewers create, compare, approve, publish, and roll back database-backed knowledge revisions through one transactional workflow.
epics.exit_criteria: Draft-to-release flow works end to end; reviewer authorization is enforced; release manifests are immutable; active alias rollback preserves all history.

epics.name: Index Compiler & Versioned Index Releases
epics.outcome: Source spans and published knowledge revisions compile into stable, incremental, rebuildable retrieval units promoted atomically through aliases.
epics.exit_criteria: Lexical/vector/relationship projections tersedia; diff hanya recompute dependency berubah; clean rebuild equivalent; alias promotion atomic.

epics.name: Query Planning & Hybrid Retrieval
epics.outcome: Query Indonesia, Arab, dan mixed direncanakan terstruktur; exact lookup diprioritaskan; lexical/vector difilter dan difusion dengan trace lengkap.
epics.exit_criteria: Plan tersimpan; exact identifier/quote tidak hanya memakai embedding; RRF visible; akses lintas scope tidak bocor.

epics.name: Evidence Selection, Sufficiency & Adaptive Context
epics.outcome: Candidate direrank, dideduplikasi, didiversifikasi, diperluas secara struktural, dinilai kecukupannya, lalu dirakit dalam adaptive context budget.
epics.exit_criteria: Final evidence mempertahankan syarat/pengecualian; contradiction/coverage terdeteksi; weak evidence menghasilkan abstain/escalate; context manifest tersimpan.

epics.name: Model Gateway & Structured Generation
epics.outcome: Generation melalui gateway model-agnostic untuk local/frontier provider dan menghasilkan answer contract dengan claim-to-evidence mapping.
epics.exit_criteria: Dua adapter provider lolos contract suite; provider diganti via config; invalid output diperbaiki sekali atau ditolak.

epics.name: Citation Validation & Answer Reproducibility
epics.outcome: Citation, quotation, claim support, dan attribution divalidasi sebelum tampil; satu repair attempt; answer trace reproducible.
epics.exit_criteria: Broken citation tidak publish; quote mismatch direpair/remove; critical failure berakhir abstain; evidence pack dapat replay.

epics.name: Grounded Chat Experience & Feedback
epics.outcome: Chat multilingual merender jawaban/source cards transparan, melakukan fresh retrieval per turn, dan menghubungkan feedback ke trace.
epics.exit_criteria: Chat ID/AR/mixed dan RTL lolos; semua citation membuka span; follow-up retrieval baru; feedback linked ke revisions.
epics.fr_ids: FR-CHAT-001, FR-CHAT-003, FR-CHAT-004, FR-CHAT-005, FR-CHAT-006, FR-LLM-004

epics.name: Retrieval Inspector, Configuration & Operations
epics.outcome: Developer/operator melihat seluruh retrieval decision, mengelola provider/prompt/flags dengan safe rollout, dan membedakan failure antar-subsystem.
epics.exit_criteria: Inspector menampilkan planner sampai final context; config audited/rollbackable; ops console mengklasifikasikan source/index/retrieval/model/validation failure.

epics.name: Evaluation, Comparison & Release Gates
epics.outcome: Evaluation sets/runs terversi memisahkan retrieval dari generation, membandingkan revision secara identik, dan memblokir promote saat threshold kritis gagal.
epics.exit_criteria: Retrieval-only dan E2E report tersedia; comparison deterministik; gate result tersimpan; release gagal promote bila critical gate gagal.

migrations.purpose: Aktifkan pgcrypto, pgvector, pg_trgm; buat UUID/timestamp helper dan immutability primitives.
migrations.objects: extensions: pgcrypto, vector, pg_trgm; functions: set_updated_at(), reject_mutation()
migrations.constraints_indexes: UTC timestamptz convention; extension availability check; no business tables.
migrations.rollback: Drop helper functions; extension hanya di-drop pada environment kosong.
migrations.verification: Smoke test gen_random_uuid(), trigram, dan vector operator.

migrations.purpose: Simpan identity, tenant membership, roles, dan permissions untuk API authorization.
migrations.objects: tenants, users, user_identities, tenant_memberships, roles, permissions, role_permissions, membership_roles
migrations.constraints_indexes: Unique issuer+subject; unique tenant/user membership; constrained role grants.
migrations.rollback: Setelah berisi data gunakan expand/contract, bukan destructive rollback.
migrations.verification: User role tenant A tidak memberi akses tenant B.

migrations.purpose: Model access scope dan audit event append-only.
migrations.constraints_indexes: Audit immutable; indexes tenant/actor/entity/trace/time; scope hierarchy unique.
migrations.frs: FR-SRC-001, FR-RAG-004, FR-KNW-006, FR-STU-006, FR-VAL-004, FR-EVAL-004
migrations.rollback: Audit history tidak dihapus; archive bila perlu.
migrations.verification: UPDATE/DELETE audit ditolak; scope lookup lolos test.

migrations.purpose: Stable source identity dengan metadata bibliografis, owner, rights, dan access scope.
migrations.constraints_indexes: Required metadata; stable UUID; tenant/scope and bibliographic indexes.
migrations.rollback: Tidak destructive setelah direferensikan; gunakan corrective migration.
migrations.verification: Insert tanpa metadata wajib gagal; source_id stabil saat metadata update.

migrations.purpose: Version source files content-addressed dan deprecation tanpa menghapus historical trace.
migrations.constraints_indexes: Unique source+revision; immutable hash/storage key; no hard delete when referenced.
migrations.rollback: Move application pointer; preserve object/revision rows.
migrations.verification: Overwrite hash/key ditolak; deprecated revision tetap resolve.

migrations.purpose: Catat processor plugin, ingestion jobs, attempts, warnings, dan manifests.
migrations.constraints_indexes: Processor name+version unique; idempotency key; manifest schema/version and status timestamps.
migrations.rollback: Jobs/manifests historical; deprecate contract, jangan drop data.
migrations.verification: Successful fixture selalu memiliki manifest, warnings, processor version.

migrations.purpose: Representasikan page/section/span yang stabil dan resolvable ke original source.
migrations.constraints_indexes: Stable span_id; valid offsets/ordinals; normalized boxes; original text immutable.
migrations.rollback: Referenced spans tidak di-drop; supersede melalui revision mapping.

migrations.purpose: Simpan raw OCR immutable dan human correction revisions.
migrations.constraints_indexes: Raw append-only; correction parent chain; current pointer; editor/reason required.
migrations.rollback: Rollback current correction pointer; retain all history.
migrations.verification: Edit membuat revision baru; pre-edit OCR tetap dapat dibuka.

migrations.purpose: Create canonical typed knowledge concepts and immutable concept revisions in PostgreSQL.
migrations.constraints_indexes: Stable concept_id; unique concept_id+revision_number and content_hash; submitted/published revisions immutable; current draft/published pointers use FKs.
migrations.rollback: Do not drop canonical knowledge after use; use forward-compatible migrations and move current pointers or release aliases.
migrations.verification: Revision creation is append-only; deterministic hashes match; current draft and published pointers resolve correctly.

migrations.purpose: Store generation provenance, human verification, staleness, reviewer notes, typed concept relationships, and exact source-span links.
migrations.objects: knowledge_revision_provenance, knowledge_verifications, knowledge_reviewer_notes, knowledge_links, concept_source_spans, knowledge_staleness_events
migrations.constraints_indexes: Typed target FKs; active-link uniqueness; cross-scope checks; published verification pins exact source revisions and spans.
migrations.rollback: Preserve verification and link history; correct by adding new revisions/events.
migrations.verification: Broken or unauthorized targets fail; published revisions expose verifier, time, source revision, and exact spans.

migrations.purpose: Store database changesets, review events, immutable knowledge release manifests, active aliases, and rollback history.
migrations.objects: knowledge_changesets, changeset_items, review_events, knowledge_releases, knowledge_release_items, knowledge_release_aliases
migrations.constraints_indexes: Valid state transitions; reviewer authorization; release items pin approved revisions; manifest hash immutable; one active production alias.
migrations.rollback: Move the production alias to a prior release; retain all releases and revisions.
migrations.verification: Unauthorized approval fails; release items cannot change after publish; publish and rollback preserve full history.

migrations.purpose: Version normalization/embedding/index config dan staging/production aliases.
migrations.objects: normalization_profiles, embedding_models, index_configurations, index_releases, index_release_dependencies, index_aliases
migrations.constraints_indexes: Unique config hash; release pins dependencies; one alias target; atomic promotion.
migrations.rollback: Move alias back; retain derived release rows.
migrations.verification: Trace resolves exact config/model/profile; alias swap atomic.

migrations.purpose: Store retrieval units compiled from source spans and published knowledge revisions, plus lexical, embedding, and relationship projections.
migrations.constraints_indexes: Stable logical unit ID; source/knowledge lineage fields; GIN/trigram indexes; model-partitioned HNSW; access/topic/language/madhhab indexes.
migrations.frs: FR-IDX-001, FR-IDX-002, FR-IDX-003, FR-RAG-002, FR-RAG-003, FR-RAG-004, FR-RAG-005
migrations.rollback: Safe to rebuild; never sole evidence identity.
migrations.verification: Clean rebuild retains logical IDs and hashes; source and knowledge lineage resolves; scoped lexical/vector/relationship queries work.

migrations.purpose: Conversation turns, preferences, categorized feedback linked to answer/trace revisions.
migrations.constraints_indexes: Tenant/user scope; ordered turns; category checks; feedback pins revisions.
migrations.verification: Follow-up has new retrieval_trace_id; feedback pins answer/revisions.

migrations.purpose: Persist plans, candidates, filters, scores, exclusions, sufficiency, dan context manifests.
migrations.objects: query_plans, retrieval_traces, retrieval_candidates, retrieval_filter_events, evidence_assessments, context_manifests, context_manifest_items
migrations.constraints_indexes: Completed traces immutable; lane/rank/score; selection/exclusion reason; pinned index release; token totals.
migrations.rollback: Retain traces; introduce new schema versions instead of rewrite.
migrations.verification: Query replay recovers plan, lanes, filters, fusion, assessment, context order.

migrations.purpose: Version provider/model config, secret refs, prompts, flags, rollout rules.
migrations.objects: provider_configs, model_configs, provider_secret_refs, prompt_templates, prompt_versions, feature_flags, rollout_rules, configuration_aliases
migrations.constraints_indexes: No raw secrets; promoted versions immutable; one active alias; audit reason required.
migrations.rollback: Move config alias to prior version.
migrations.verification: Provider/prompt/flag switch via config with audit/rollback.

migrations.purpose: Structured answers, sections, claims, evidence mappings, citations, model usage, validation/repair.
migrations.objects: answers, answer_sections, answer_claims, claim_evidence, citations, model_invocations, validation_runs, validation_issues, repair_attempts
migrations.constraints_indexes: Answer pins all revisions; citation FK canonical span; one default repair; publish gated by validation.
migrations.rollback: Published answers immutable; corrections create new revision.
migrations.verification: Invalid citation/critical issue cannot publish; evidence pack reconstructable.

migrations.purpose: Versioned eval sets/cases, expected evidence, runs, comparisons, deterministic gate artifacts.
migrations.objects: evaluation_sets, evaluation_set_versions, evaluation_cases, expected_evidence, evaluation_runs, evaluation_case_results, evaluation_comparisons, gate_policies, gate_results
migrations.constraints_indexes: Owner required; set version immutable; run pins revisions; comparison same cases; gate input/result hash.
migrations.rollback: Never delete historical runs/gates; supersede policy.
migrations.verification: Critical regression creates failed gate and blocks promotion.

migrations.purpose: Service health/events, failure taxonomy, RLS policies, dashboard read models.
migrations.objects: service_components, service_health_events, operation_failures, dashboard_source_health_v, dashboard_open_work_v, dashboard_release_health_v; RLS policies
migrations.constraints_indexes: Tenant RLS; controlled failure codes; authorized dashboard views.
migrations.rollback: Do not disable RLS in production; recreate views/policies via forward fix.
migrations.verification: Cross-tenant SQL returns zero; dashboard counts reconcile; failures identify subsystem.

tickets.title: Bootstrap monorepo and service boundaries
tickets.user_story: Sebagai engineer, saya membutuhkan baseline web, API, worker, dan shared packages agar delivery berikutnya memakai contract dan tooling konsisten.
tickets.scope: Buat Bun workspace untuk API/worker/shared, React+Vite app, typed configuration, lint/test/build scripts, dan CI gate.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Given checkout baru, when bootstrap dijalankan, then web/API/worker dapat start; Given pull request, when CI berjalan, then typecheck, lint, unit test, dan build wajib pass; Shared DTO tidak mengimpor framework-specific code.
tickets.test_evidence: CI run hijau; smoke test ketiga service; architecture README.

tickets.title: Provide reproducible local infrastructure
tickets.user_story: Sebagai engineer, saya dapat menjalankan dependency utama secara lokal tanpa konfigurasi manual yang rapuh.
tickets.scope: Sediakan dev stack untuk PostgreSQL+pgvector, S3-compatible storage, local OIDC, migrations, seed, dan health checks.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Fresh environment naik dengan satu command; pgvector/pg_trgm tersedia; bucket dan DB diinisialisasi idempotent; teardown tidak menghapus volume kecuali explicit reset.
tickets.test_evidence: Automated local-stack smoke test; setup guide diverifikasi engineer kedua.

tickets.title: Implement OIDC authentication and application sessions
tickets.user_story: Sebagai pengguna terautentikasi, saya masuk melalui OIDC dan setiap request memiliki principal tervalidasi.
tickets.scope: Implement login/callback/logout, issuer/audience validation, short-lived app session, user upsert, dan CSRF/session protections.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Invalid issuer/audience ditolak; logout mencabut app session; first login membuat identity sekali; protected route mengembalikan 401 tanpa session.
tickets.test_evidence: OIDC integration tests; security negative tests; session lifecycle trace.

tickets.title: Implement tenant RBAC and access-scope authorization
tickets.user_story: Sebagai administrator, saya membatasi editor, reviewer, operator, dan reader berdasarkan tenant serta access scope.
tickets.scope: Buat permission middleware/policy service, role grants, resource-scope checks, dan deny-by-default contract untuk API/jobs.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Reviewer-only action ditolak untuk editor; tenant A tidak dapat membaca tenant B; background job membawa service scope; deny decision mencatat reason code.
tickets.test_evidence: Permission matrix tests; cross-tenant integration tests; threat-model checklist.

tickets.title: Create append-only audit event service
tickets.user_story: Sebagai reviewer/operator, saya dapat mengetahui siapa mengubah apa, kapan, dan dengan alasan apa.
tickets.scope: Sediakan audit SDK/API untuk changeset, release, configuration, validation override, gate, dan authorization-sensitive events.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Event memuat actor, tenant, action, entity, before/after reference, reason, trace_id, timestamp; update/delete ditolak; business transaction dan audit konsisten.
tickets.test_evidence: Append-only DB test; event contract tests; sample audit timeline.

tickets.title: Standardize correlation IDs, OpenTelemetry and health contracts
tickets.user_story: Sebagai operator, saya dapat mengikuti satu request dari ingestion/retrieval sampai model/validation dan melihat dependency yang gagal.
tickets.scope: Implement trace_id propagation, OTel spans/metrics/log attributes, readiness/liveness, component health schema, dan redaction policy.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Semua API/job/model calls memiliki trace_id; health membedakan unavailable/degraded/healthy; sensitive content tidak masuk log default; trace menghubungkan retrieval dan answer IDs.
tickets.test_evidence: Distributed trace export; health failure injection; log-redaction tests.

tickets.title: Create immutable source registry schema and API
tickets.user_story: Sebagai source manager, saya membuat source record lengkap sebelum file diproses.
tickets.scope: Implement create/read/update-metadata/list API dengan required bibliographic metadata, rights status, owner, tenant, dan access scope.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Create tanpa field wajib ditolak dengan field errors; source_id stabil; metadata edit diaudit; processor tidak dapat start tanpa source revision valid.
tickets.test_evidence: API contract tests; schema validation tests; audit assertion.

tickets.title: Implement content-addressed immutable upload pipeline
tickets.user_story: Sebagai source manager, original file disimpan satu kali dengan hash dan tidak dapat ditimpa diam-diam.
tickets.scope: Stream upload, compute SHA-256, store immutable object key, capture MIME/size, dan create source revision transactionally.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Stored hash cocok dengan upload; same hash reused/detected tanpa overwrite; object key immutable; partial upload tidak membuat active revision.
tickets.test_evidence: Large-file integration test; hash mismatch test; object immutability test.

tickets.title: Implement source revision and deprecation lifecycle
tickets.user_story: Sebagai source manager, saya menambah revision atau mendeprecate revision lama tanpa memutus answer trace.
tickets.scope: Implement revision numbering/status transitions, deprecation reason, replacement pointer, dan historical resolver.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Deprecation tidak hard-delete; old source_revision_id tetap membuka file/metadata; new processing memakai latest eligible revision; lifecycle diaudit.
tickets.test_evidence: Revision transition tests; historical citation resolution; deprecation smoke test.

tickets.title: Build source registry and revision timeline UI
tickets.user_story: Sebagai editor, saya dapat mencari source, melihat rights/owner/status, dan memahami revision history.
tickets.scope: Buat list/filter/detail, revision timeline, upload/deprecate actions sesuai permission, serta link ke processing/viewer.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Metadata wajib terlihat; deprecated revision berlabel namun tetap dapat dibuka; unauthorized action tetap ditolak server; error upload actionable.
tickets.test_evidence: Component tests; Playwright lifecycle flow; keyboard accessibility check.

tickets.title: Enforce source immutability and historical-reference invariants
tickets.user_story: Sebagai tim, kami memiliki regression tests yang mencegah overwrite atau deletion merusak evidence history.
tickets.scope: Tambahkan DB/API/property tests untuk mutation attempts, concurrent revision creation, deprecation, dan referenced records.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Concurrent revision tidak collision; source hash/key update ditolak; referenced revision tidak dapat dihapus; rollback app tetap compatible dengan resolver.
tickets.test_evidence: Automated integration suite in CI; concurrency test report.

tickets.title: Define processor plugin contract and processing manifest
tickets.user_story: Sebagai ingestion engineer, saya menambah processor format tanpa mengubah orchestration core.
tickets.scope: Define typed processor interface, capability declaration, artifacts, warnings/errors, version, idempotency key, dan manifest schema.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Unknown format menghasilkan unsupported error; setiap success menulis versioned manifest; retry idempotent; failure classified dan traceable.
tickets.test_evidence: Contract test kit; sample no-op processor; retry/idempotency integration test.

tickets.title: Implement canonical page, section and stable span model
tickets.user_story: Sebagai retrieval/UX engineer, saya memiliki passage IDs stabil yang membuka lokasi sumber tepat.
tickets.scope: Implement page/section/span creation, text offsets, optional boxes, headings, adjacency, footnotes, dan resolver APIs.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Span berada dalam parent boundary; stable ID deterministic untuk unchanged content; resolver returns exact revision/page/coordinates; original text immutable.
tickets.test_evidence: Fixture resolver tests; random-span round-trip; coordinate overlay snapshot.

tickets.title: Implement PDF and scanned-PDF processors
tickets.user_story: Sebagai editor, PDF digital maupun scanned menghasilkan manifest dan page boundaries yang dapat diperiksa.
tickets.scope: Detect text vs scan, extract page text/layout, preserve page images, identify heading/footnote hints, route scans to OCR.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Page count/order sesuai original; encrypted/corrupt/layout issues menjadi warnings; each span resolves to page; processor version tercatat.
tickets.test_evidence: Golden PDF fixtures: digital, two-column, Arabic, mixed, scanned; manifest diff tests.

tickets.title: Implement EPUB, HTML, Markdown and TXT processors
tickets.user_story: Sebagai editor, format text-native menghasilkan section/span hierarchy konsisten.
tickets.scope: Parse EPUB spine/headings, sanitized HTML, Markdown headings/footnotes, dan TXT sections sambil mempertahankan anchors.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: External script/style tidak dieksekusi; order deterministic; anchors resolve exact section; malformed input memberi warnings, bukan silent truncation.
tickets.test_evidence: Golden fixtures per format; sanitizer tests; deterministic manifest hashes.

tickets.title: Implement structured JSON and CSV import processors
tickets.user_story: Sebagai data curator, saya memetakan dataset terstruktur ke source sections/spans secara eksplisit.
tickets.scope: Support schema mapping, row/item identifiers, text templates, validation report, dan rejected-row artifact.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Import membutuhkan mapping profile; invalid rows dilaporkan; stable row IDs survive reorder; manifest mencatat accepted/rejected counts.
tickets.test_evidence: CSV/JSON fixtures; reorder stability; rejected-row export.

tickets.title: Implement Arabic/Indonesian OCR adapter with raw-output preservation
tickets.user_story: Sebagai editor, scanned page diproses OCR dan raw output/model metadata tetap dapat diaudit.
tickets.scope: Define OCR provider adapter, language hints, per-page confidence/layout payload, raw span storage, retry/fallback handling.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Raw OCR immutable; provider/model/version tercatat; Arabic RTL order preserved dalam fixture; retry tidak overwrite prior output.
tickets.test_evidence: OCR fixture benchmark; raw-output immutability; failure/retry trace.

tickets.title: Build side-by-side OCR review and correction workflow
tickets.user_story: Sebagai reviewer, saya membandingkan page image dengan OCR, memperbaiki teks, dan tetap melihat versi sebelum edit.
tickets.scope: Render page image+text, synchronized selection, edit/save, revision diff, reviewer attribution, dan restore prior correction.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Save membuat correction revision baru; raw OCR unchanged; Arabic editing respects RTL; old answer refs tidak berubah.
tickets.test_evidence: Playwright correction flow; RTL snapshot; history/restore integration test.

tickets.title: Define canonical database knowledge schema
tickets.user_story: Sebagai knowledge engineer, saya memiliki schema typed untuk canonical PostgreSQL records dan API contracts.
tickets.scope: Define concept identity, immutable revisions, Markdown body, topic, madhhab, source refs, authority, review state, validity, staleness, and access scope.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Database and API schemas align; required published fields are enforced; schema version and migration policy are explicit; no runtime dependency on external knowledge files.
tickets.test_evidence: Schema fixtures; architecture sign-off; generated API and field reference.

tickets.title: Define required-field profiles for all concept types
tickets.user_story: Sebagai editor, setiap concept type hanya meminta field relevan dan memiliki aturan jelas.
tickets.scope: Specify definition, fiqh position, evidence, rule, exception, comparison, glossary term, source note, dan policy profiles.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Sembilan type memiliki required/optional fields dan examples; invalid combinations rejected; UI metadata generated.
tickets.test_evidence: Profile unit tests; valid/invalid sample corpus; reviewer sign-off.

tickets.title: Implement immutable concept revision service and content hashing
tickets.user_story: Sebagai platform, saya menyimpan setiap edit sebagai immutable concept revision dengan deterministic content hash dan explicit current pointers.
tickets.scope: Implement create/read revision APIs, typed metadata validation, Markdown body storage, revision numbering, optimistic concurrency, content hashing, and draft/published pointers.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Submitted or published revisions cannot update in place; same canonical content yields the same hash; revision history remains addressable; concurrent stale edits are rejected.
tickets.test_evidence: Append-only revision tests; content-hash golden tests; optimistic-concurrency integration test.

tickets.title: Implement provenance, verification, staleness and reviewer notes
tickets.user_story: Sebagai reviewer, saya melihat bagaimana concept dibuat, siapa memverifikasi, source revision mana, dan kapan harus ditinjau.
tickets.scope: Implement generation method, verification actor/time, status, stale_after, reviewer notes, supersession, dan source revision pins.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Published concept membutuhkan verifier/source revision; staleness deterministic; notes preserve author/time; superseded concept tetap resolve.
tickets.test_evidence: Governance rules tests; stale-query fixtures; API snapshot.

tickets.title: Implement typed concept and source-span links
tickets.user_story: Sebagai editor, saya menghubungkan rule, exception, evidence, comparison, dan exact source span dengan relationship eksplisit.
tickets.scope: Define relationship registry, database CRUD, reverse lookup, stable source-span references, cycle policy, and scope validation.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Target and relationship type are validated; source revision is pinned; reverse queries work; cross-scope targets are rejected; link history remains traceable.
tickets.test_evidence: Relationship integration tests; cross-scope negative tests; revision-history test.

tickets.title: Create publish-time knowledge conformance and broken-link validator
tickets.user_story: Sebagai publisher, saya mendapat validation report yang memblokir concept tidak valid sebelum release.
tickets.scope: Compose schema, type-profile, provenance, relationship, source-span, and access-scope checks with machine-readable codes and human-readable locations.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Blocking errors prevent publication; report identifies concept, revision, field, relationship, or span; warning policy is versioned; identical input yields identical report.
tickets.test_evidence: Conformance suite in CI; broken-link fixture; deterministic snapshot.

tickets.title: Build schema-driven concept editor and database draft save
tickets.user_story: Sebagai editor, saya mengelola curated knowledge melalui typed forms dan preview tanpa menulis database commands atau repository files.
tickets.scope: Generate forms from type profiles, provide Markdown body editor and preview, show field errors, and save an immutable draft revision inside a database changeset.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Each type renders correct fields; save creates a valid database revision and changeset item; stale edits are rejected; unsaved-change recovery works.
tickets.test_evidence: Component tests per type; Playwright create/edit/reload; stored revision snapshot.

tickets.title: Build source viewer with exact-span selection for concepts
tickets.user_story: Sebagai editor, saya membuka source di samping concept dan membuat evidence reference dari selection tepat.
tickets.scope: Render page/section, search/navigation, text/box highlight, stable span selection, attach evidence to concept.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Selection creates stable source_span ref; reload highlights same revision; page image dan corrected text distinguishable; cross-scope blocked.
tickets.test_evidence: Playwright select-link-reload; coordinate/text snapshot; permission test.

tickets.title: Implement changeset workflow state machine and API
tickets.user_story: Sebagai editor/reviewer, saya memindahkan changeset melalui draft, submit, request changes, approve, publish, reject, dan rollback terkontrol.
tickets.scope: Implement transitions, optimistic locking, comments/reasons, authorization, dan domain events.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Invalid transition rejected; concurrent update conflicts; submit freezes review revision; every transition audited; only reviewer approves/publishes.
tickets.test_evidence: State-machine tests; concurrency test; permission matrix.

tickets.title: Implement database revision diff and changeset snapshot service
tickets.user_story: Sebagai reviewer, saya menerima reproducible diff antara base dan proposed database revisions tanpa external repository synchronization.
tickets.scope: Snapshot base/proposed revision IDs and generate typed metadata, Markdown body, source-span, and relationship diffs with stale-base detection.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Diff pins exact base/proposed revisions; repeated generation is deterministic; stale bases are reported without data loss; actor and changeset are audited.
tickets.test_evidence: Database diff golden tests; stale-base conflict fixture; audit and deterministic snapshot.

tickets.title: Build changeset review, diff and approval UI
tickets.user_story: Sebagai reviewer, saya melihat typed and Markdown database revision diffs, evidence, and validation results before requesting changes or approving.
tickets.scope: Build queue/detail, metadata and Markdown diff, evidence links, comments, action controls, and permission-aware states.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Reviewer sees exact base/proposed revision IDs; blocking validation disables approval; request-changes requires a note; stale review prompts refresh; keyboard flow is accessible.
tickets.test_evidence: Playwright submit-review-approve; stale review; a11y audit.

tickets.title: Implement immutable database knowledge release, atomic publish and rollback
tickets.user_story: Sebagai release manager, saya publish approved concept revisions as an immutable release and return to a prior release through an alias change.
tickets.scope: Create release manifest and hash, pin approved revision IDs, change the active alias transactionally, emit publication events, provide resolver and rollback actions.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Only approved revisions enter a release; manifest hash is stable; alias swap is atomic; rollback moves the alias; every historical release remains addressable and audited.
tickets.test_evidence: End-to-end release and rollback; concurrent-reader atomicity test; manifest-hash verification.

tickets.title: Build Knowledge Studio health and work dashboard
tickets.user_story: Sebagai editor/operator, saya melihat source health, unpublished changes, stale concepts, broken links, failed jobs, dan open feedback.
tickets.scope: Build aggregate cards, filters, refresh/error states, dan drill-down links preserving filters.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Semua required cards menunjukkan authorized count/last refresh; click membuka actionable records; zero/error/loading distinct; counts reconcile.
tickets.test_evidence: Dashboard contract tests; count reconciliation; Playwright drill-down.

tickets.title: Build retrieval-unit compiler for source spans and published knowledge revisions
tickets.user_story: Sebagai search platform, saya mengompilasi canonical evidence dan curated knowledge menjadi retrieval units terversi.
tickets.scope: Define unit kinds, chunk and section policy, source and knowledge revision lineage, parent refs, access scope, topic, madhhab, authority, and language metadata.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Every unit pins source_revision_id and/or knowledge_revision_id; only active release revisions compile; parent and scope are present; output hash is deterministic.
tickets.test_evidence: Golden compiler fixtures; lineage test; unpublished exclusion test.

tickets.title: Implement stable retrieval-unit identity and structural lineage
tickets.user_story: Sebagai indexer, unchanged logical units retain IDs across releases sementara changed content terversi.
tickets.scope: Implement logical unit key, version/hash, parent/adjacent lineage, tombstones, dan supersession mapping.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Unchanged fixture retains ID; changed text changes hash/version; moved-section policy documented; deleted unit tombstoned.
tickets.test_evidence: Stability regression suite; fixture diff report.

tickets.title: Implement normalization profiles and lexical search projection
tickets.user_story: Sebagai retriever, saya memiliki original/normalized text dan FTS/trigram indexes dengan profile version traceable.
tickets.scope: Implement Unicode/Arabic normalization, profile hash/version, FTS vectors, trigram/exact fields, rebuild job.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Original unchanged; profile recorded; Arabic fixtures searchable; expected indexes used; profile change triggers recompute.
tickets.test_evidence: Normalization golden tests; EXPLAIN evidence; lexical benchmark smoke.

tickets.title: Implement model-versioned embedding and vector projection
tickets.user_story: Sebagai retriever, saya menghasilkan embeddings terversi dan dapat mengganti model tanpa mengubah canonical knowledge.
tickets.scope: Implement embedding adapter, batching/retry, dimension config, versioned storage/partition, active-model index, usage telemetry.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Embedding pins model/version/dimension/input hash; unchanged input reused; model switch makes new projection; retries idempotent.
tickets.test_evidence: Fake-provider contract tests; reuse test; vector query smoke.

tickets.title: Implement relationship-index projection
tickets.user_story: Sebagai retriever, saya memperluas evidence melalui typed concept, parent, adjacency, footnote, dan source relations.
tickets.scope: Compile canonical links/structure ke release-scoped edges dengan type/direction/weight.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Edges pin index release; broken canonical links not compiled; reverse traversal available; scope inherited/enforced.
tickets.test_evidence: Graph traversal fixtures; broken-link exclusion; scope propagation.

tickets.title: Implement incremental indexing from source and knowledge-release diffs
tickets.user_story: Sebagai operator, perubahan kecil hanya menghitung ulang unit/dependency terdampak.
tickets.scope: Build event-driven diff planner, dependency graph, work batches, reuse decisions, and release build summary from source and knowledge changes.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Unchanged units/embeddings reused; affected links/parents recomputed; deleted items tombstoned; rerun idempotent; summary counts available.
tickets.test_evidence: Incremental fixture; idempotency; dependency assertions.

tickets.title: Implement clean rebuild and index-equivalence verification
tickets.user_story: Sebagai release manager, saya dapat membuang derived index dan membangun ulang dengan hasil logis ekuivalen.
tickets.scope: Create clean rebuild command, deterministic manifests, unit/content/edge comparison, tolerated fields, failure report.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Rebuild from pinned source and knowledge releases yields the same logical IDs, hashes, and relationships; mismatch blocks ready state; canonical data remains untouched.
tickets.test_evidence: Full fixture rebuild; equivalence report artifact.

tickets.title: Implement staging/production index aliases and atomic promotion
tickets.user_story: Sebagai release manager, saya mempromosikan validated index atomically dan dapat melihat model/normalization config yang dipakai.
tickets.scope: Implement release states, aliases, validation hook, transactional swap, rollback, dan resolver API.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Only ready/passed release promotes; concurrent query sees old/new, never partial; trace resolves exact config; rollback audited.
tickets.test_evidence: Concurrent alias-swap; invalid release block; resolver contract.

tickets.title: Implement query normalization and ID/Arabic/mixed language detection
tickets.user_story: Sebagai planner, saya mempertahankan query asli sambil membuat normalized representation untuk Indonesia, Arab, dan mixed.
tickets.scope: Implement Unicode cleanup, controlled Arabic normalization, script/language spans, approved aliases, immutable original query.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Original stored unchanged; mixed query detected tanpa forced translation; normalization version recorded; numbers/IDs preserved.
tickets.test_evidence: Language matrix; normalization golden tests; ID preservation.

tickets.title: Implement structured query planner and persisted plan
tickets.user_story: Sebagai retrieval system, saya menentukan intent, risk, madhhab/scope, mode, lanes, filters, dan context profile eksplisit.
tickets.scope: Define planner schema, rule-first baseline plus optional model adapter, reason codes, override policy, trace persistence.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Plan schema valid; exact/standard/comparison/calculation/research covered; requested scope retained; low confidence/risk visible; plan stored before retrieval.
tickets.test_evidence: Planner fixtures; schema contract; trace assertion.

tickets.title: Implement exact identifier lookup lane
tickets.user_story: Sebagai pengguna, ayah/hadith/source/page/section identifiers diselesaikan deterministic sebelum semantic retrieval.
tickets.scope: Implement identifier parsers/lookup registry untuk corpus keys dan bibliographic/page refs.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Recognized ID triggers exact lane; ambiguous numbering returns scoped alternatives; result pins revision/span; no embedding-only fallback.
tickets.test_evidence: Identifier fixture corpus; ambiguity tests; resolver integration.

tickets.title: Implement exact Arabic quotation lookup lane
tickets.user_story: Sebagai pengguna, frasa Arab exact ditemukan melalui original/controlled-normalized text, bukan hanya vector similarity.
tickets.scope: Build phrase detection, exact/normalized search, occurrence ranking, boundary/context extraction, quote-match metadata.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Original exact ranks first; normalized match labels transformations; common phrase asks disambiguation; result includes canonical span/context.
tickets.test_evidence: Arabic fixtures with/without harakat; false positives; ranking snapshot.

tickets.title: Implement lexical retrieval with metadata filtering
tickets.user_story: Sebagai retriever, saya mengambil lexical candidates dari active index dengan publication, language, topic, madhhab, edition, dan access filters.
tickets.scope: Implement PostgreSQL FTS/trigram query builder, candidate contract, scores/ranks, filter reasons, configurable top-k.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Only active release queried; filters applied in SQL; candidate includes lineage/score/rank; expected indexes used.
tickets.test_evidence: Retrieval integration; filter matrix; EXPLAIN artifact; scope negative test.

tickets.title: Implement semantic vector retrieval with metadata filtering
tickets.user_story: Sebagai retriever, saya mengambil semantic candidates untuk paraphrase/cross-language tanpa melewati scope policy.
tickets.scope: Generate query embedding via configured model, execute release-scoped vector search, prefilter metadata/access, record distance/rank.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Query uses same embedding config; prefilters applied before model exposure; trace includes model/version/distance; failure classified.
tickets.test_evidence: Semantic fixtures; model mismatch rejection; access leak; failure injection.

tickets.title: Run retrieval lanes in parallel and fuse with RRF
tickets.user_story: Sebagai retriever, saya menggabungkan exact, lexical, dan vector candidates deterministic tanpa mencampur raw score scales.
tickets.scope: Implement lane orchestration, timeout policy, candidate dedupe, RRF, exact boost policy, full trace.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Fusion reproducible; candidates retain lane ranks/scores; optional lane failure degrades per policy; exact priority tested.
tickets.test_evidence: RRF unit tests; timeout/failure; golden fused ranking.

tickets.title: Enforce permission and metadata filters before evidence leaves retrieval
tickets.user_story: Sebagai security owner, candidate di luar permission tidak masuk reranker, context, inspector, atau model.
tickets.scope: Centralize scope predicate, candidate postcondition, inspector redaction, cache-key scoping, service-account policy.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Unauthorized unit absent from all results; cache cannot cross scope; inspector same policy; policy service failure is fail-closed.
tickets.test_evidence: Cross-scope adversarial suite; cache isolation; fail-closed test.

tickets.title: Implement reranker adapter and relevance policy
tickets.user_story: Sebagai retrieval system, saya menilai fused candidates lebih teliti sebelum context assembly.
tickets.scope: Define reranker provider interface, batching, score handling, timeout/fallback, payload, dan versioned config.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Reranker version/config logged; fallback preserves fused order with warning; bounded batch/top-k; no unauthorized candidate introduced.
tickets.test_evidence: Fake adapter contract; fallback test; rerank benchmark sample.

tickets.title: Implement candidate deduplication and source/madhhab diversity
tickets.user_story: Sebagai answer system, final evidence tidak didominasi duplicate spans atau satu source ketika query meminta comparison.
tickets.scope: Implement overlap/content/source dedupe, per-source caps, requested-madhhab coverage, authority/diversity policy, reason codes.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Overlapping spans collapse; requested madhhabs represented when available; exclusions recorded; policy deterministic.
tickets.test_evidence: Dedupe fixtures; comparative diversity tests; exclusion snapshot.

tickets.title: Expand parent sections, adjacency, footnotes and linked concepts
tickets.user_story: Sebagai model, saya menerima syarat, pengecualian, heading, dan konteks struktural, bukan isolated fragment.
tickets.scope: Implement expansion rules/budgets untuk parent, adjacent spans, footnotes, definitions, evidence, exceptions, typed links, cycle guards.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Selected fragment mendapat structural context; no cross-scope expansion; cycles stop; every added item has relation/reason/token estimate.
tickets.test_evidence: Expansion fixtures; cycle test; condition/exception regression.

tickets.title: Assess evidence sufficiency, contradiction and coverage gaps
tickets.user_story: Sebagai answer policy, saya mengetahui apakah evidence cukup, parsial, bertentangan, atau kehilangan posisi yang diminta.
tickets.scope: Define evidence-status schema dan deterministic features plus optional assessor untuk exact support, authority, requested scope, contradiction, missing positions.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Emits sufficient/partial/insufficient/contradictory dengan reason codes; missing madhhab detected; exact request tanpa exact support insufficient; result stored.
tickets.test_evidence: Assessment fixtures; contradiction false-positive tests; reviewer-approved examples.

tickets.title: Implement abstention and escalation policy
tickets.user_story: Sebagai pengguna, evidence lemah atau contradictory tidak disajikan sebagai ruling definitif.
tickets.scope: Map risk/evidence states ke answer allowed, qualified, abstain, atau scholar-review escalation dengan reason/message contract.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Insufficient exact support abstains; sensitive contradiction escalates; partial evidence language constrained; decision stored; no numeric confidence.
tickets.test_evidence: Policy table tests; sensitive-case fixtures; UX copy review.

tickets.title: Build adaptive context profiles and immutable context manifest
tickets.user_story: Sebagai model gateway, saya menerima evidence pack terurut sesuai complexity/provider budget, bukan maximum context default.
tickets.scope: Implement Exact/Standard/Comparative/Research/Document Audit profiles, token estimation, zone order, truncation, manifest hash, logged budget.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Default not max context; items/order/token estimates stored; conditions/exceptions protected from orphan truncation; over-budget fails safely/downgrades.
tickets.test_evidence: Context golden snapshots; budget boundaries; replay equality.

tickets.title: Define model gateway interfaces and normalized error contract
tickets.user_story: Sebagai application, saya memanggil local/frontier model melalui contract sama tanpa mengubah retrieval/storage schema.
tickets.scope: Define provider/model config, generate/stream, capabilities, cancellation/timeouts, normalized errors, usage, trace hooks.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Application depends only on gateway; errors classified; provider/model IDs and usage returned; cancellation propagates; secrets absent from logs.
tickets.test_evidence: Fake-provider contract; cancellation/failure; dependency architecture check.

tickets.title: Implement local OpenAI-compatible model adapter
tickets.user_story: Sebagai operator, saya mengarahkan generation ke local endpoint berprotokol OpenAI-compatible.
tickets.scope: Implement request/response mapping, streaming, structured mode, timeout/retry, usage parsing, health check.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Adapter passes gateway suite; endpoint/model configurable; unsupported capability reported; outage classified.
tickets.test_evidence: Mock-server tests; local smoke; streaming cancellation.

tickets.title: Implement initial frontier model provider adapter
tickets.user_story: Sebagai operator, saya menggunakan satu frontier provider melalui gateway dan menggantinya via config.
tickets.scope: Implement selected provider mapping untuk context, structured output, streaming, usage, safety/errors, secret reference.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Passes same gateway suite; provider fields tidak bocor ke canonical schema; switch needs no retrieval/storage change; secrets absent from DB/log.
tickets.test_evidence: Provider sandbox/mock integration; parity report; secret scan.

tickets.title: Define structured answer and claim-to-evidence JSON schema
tickets.user_story: Sebagai UI/validator, saya menerima answer dengan sections dan material claims yang menunjuk evidence IDs.
tickets.scope: Publish versioned JSON schema untuk summary, direct statements, synthesis, differences, conditions/exceptions, limitations, follow-ups, claims/evidence.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Every material claim maps evidence; direct vs synthesis explicit; required sections defined; UI need not parse prose.
tickets.test_evidence: Valid/invalid examples; frontend/validation review; compatibility test.

tickets.title: Implement versioned grounded-generation pipeline
tickets.user_story: Sebagai answer service, saya mengirim context manifest dan prompt terversi lalu menghasilkan draft terikat evidence.
tickets.scope: Build prompt assembly, policy, evidence IDs, provider routing, streaming/draft persistence, section-aware generation.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Prompt/model/context revision pinned; only manifest evidence IDs accepted; required sections separated; failure tidak publish partial draft as valid.
tickets.test_evidence: Golden prompt; two-provider smoke; partial-stream failure.

tickets.title: Validate, repair once, or reject invalid structured model output
tickets.user_story: Sebagai answer pipeline, malformed/schema-invalid output tidak langsung ditampilkan.
tickets.scope: Implement strict parse/schema validation, deterministic coercions, one structured repair call, rejection reason, metrics.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Valid output unchanged; repair max one; unknown evidence IDs rejected; unrepaired output uses safe error/abstain; attempts traced.
tickets.test_evidence: Malformed corpus; repair-count assertion; evidence-ID injection test.

tickets.title: Validate cited source IDs, revisions, pages and spans
tickets.user_story: Sebagai pengguna, setiap citation benar-benar menunjuk canonical source location.
tickets.scope: Resolve citation IDs terhadap source revision/span/page/section dan enforce status/access sebelum publish.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Missing/mismatched ref critical; deprecated historical revision may resolve with label; citation cannot point only to retrieval unit; no broken citation publish.
tickets.test_evidence: Citation fixtures; mismatch injection; historical revision test.

tickets.title: Verify exact quotations against canonical source text
tickets.user_story: Sebagai pengguna, quotation cocok dengan canonical original text atau approved transformation.
tickets.scope: Implement exact comparison, whitespace/Unicode policy, Arabic normalization report, boundaries, mismatch severity, repair/removal instruction.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Exact match recorded; normalized-only labeled; paraphrase cannot be quotation; mismatch triggers repair/removal.
tickets.test_evidence: Arabic/Indonesian quote fixtures; ellipsis/boundary; mismatch injection.

tickets.title: Detect material claims without sufficient evidence support
tickets.user_story: Sebagai quality system, material claim tanpa supporting evidence ditandai sebelum publish.
tickets.scope: Implement claim inventory checks, evidence existence/relevance policy, direct-vs-synthesis rules, deterministic prechecks plus validator adapter.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Every material claim maps evidence; unknown/unselected evidence rejected; direct statement needs direct support; critical unsupported claim blocks.
tickets.test_evidence: Unsupported benchmark; mapping property tests; adversarial ID test.

tickets.title: Validate madhhab attribution and comparative coverage
tickets.user_story: Sebagai pengguna, pendapat tidak dinisbatkan ke mazhab salah dan missing positions tidak disamarkan.
tickets.scope: Cross-check claim attribution dengan evidence metadata/concepts, requested scope, dan comparative coverage.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Claim madhhab matches evidence/explicit comparative source; missing requested madhhab disclosed; conflicting attribution blocks; reasons auditable.
tickets.test_evidence: Scholar-reviewed fixtures; misattribution injection; missing-position test.

tickets.title: Orchestrate one repair attempt then safe abstention
tickets.user_story: Sebagai user, critical validation failure tidak berulang tanpa batas dan tidak tampil seolah valid.
tickets.scope: Run validators, compose repair instruction, invoke one repair, revalidate, then publish/qualified/abstain per policy.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Repair max one; second critical failure abstains; removed citation updates claims; decision/issues stored; invalid draft not final.
tickets.test_evidence: Repair-loop tests; persistent failure; state-transition assertions.

tickets.title: Persist complete answer trace and revision pins
tickets.user_story: Sebagai reviewer, saya melihat evidence IDs, plan, index/knowledge/prompt/model revisions, usage, dan validation result.
tickets.scope: Persist answer/sections/claims/citations, retrieval/context IDs, invocations, usage, issues, config/release hashes, trace_id.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Published answer has all pins; final trace write transactional; failed attempts preserved; authorized lookup returns full graph.
tickets.test_evidence: Trace completeness validator; transaction failure; sampled audit.

tickets.title: Provide evidence-pack replay and reproducibility API
tickets.user_story: Sebagai reviewer, saya merekonstruksi evidence pack answer lama meski active release berubah.
tickets.scope: Implement authorized replay endpoint/CLI yang resolve pinned source/knowledge/index/context/prompt/model metadata dan hashes.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Replay never substitutes current alias; item order/text/hash match manifest; missing archive explicit; access enforced.
tickets.test_evidence: Historical release replay; hash equality; permission negative.

tickets.title: Implement conversation and per-turn grounded answer API
tickets.user_story: Sebagai pengguna, follow-up memakai conversation context tetapi setiap factual turn tetap menjalankan fresh retrieval.
tickets.scope: Create conversation/message endpoints, turn orchestration, safe conversational context, new trace per turn, cancellation.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Every answer turn has unique retrieval_trace_id; prior messages cannot supply uncited facts; retry has lineage; access enforced.
tickets.test_evidence: Multi-turn tests; fresh-retrieval assertion; conversation access tests.

tickets.title: Build streaming multilingual chat shell with RTL support
tickets.user_story: Sebagai pengguna Indonesia/Arab, saya mengetik dan membaca query/jawaban ID, AR, atau mixed tanpa bidi rusak.
tickets.scope: Implement conversation UI, composer, streaming/cancel/retry, bidi-safe rendering, Arabic fallback, preserve-language behavior.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Arabic paragraphs RTL; mixed IDs readable; no auto-translation; streaming/cancel clear; keyboard/screen-reader baseline passes.
tickets.test_evidence: Visual snapshots ID/AR/mixed; Playwright; a11y audit.

tickets.title: Render structured answer sections independently
tickets.user_story: Sebagai pengguna, saya melihat summary, evidence, differences, conditions/exceptions, limitations, dan follow-up terpisah.
tickets.scope: Build versioned section components, claim citation anchors, empty-state rules, collapsed detail, safe Markdown.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: No prose parsing; claims link evidence; optional sections clean; unsafe HTML stripped; unsupported schema shows fallback.
tickets.test_evidence: Component fixtures; XSS tests; visual regression.

tickets.title: Implement evidence-status and uncertainty UX without numeric confidence
tickets.user_story: Sebagai pengguna, saya memahami sufficient/partial/contradictory/insufficient evidence tanpa pseudo-precision.
tickets.scope: Map evidence status/reasons ke labels, limitations, abstention/escalation panels, accessible explanations.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: No numeric confidence percentage; status visible near summary; abstention distinct from system error; reasons from stored assessment.
tickets.test_evidence: Content review; status matrix tests; screenshots.

tickets.title: Build source cards and deep-linked source viewer
tickets.user_story: Sebagai pengguna, setiap citation menampilkan source metadata dan membuka exact quoted span pada revision yang dipakai.
tickets.scope: Build cards for title/author/edition/page/section/verification/quote, grouped citations, deep link, highlight, deprecated label.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Every citation has card; click opens pinned revision/span; exact quote highlighted; access handled safely; verification visible.
tickets.test_evidence: Playwright citation-to-viewer; historical source; RTL quote snapshot.

tickets.title: Implement categorized feedback linked to answer and revisions
tickets.user_story: Sebagai pengguna, saya melaporkan helpful, citation, doctrinal, translation, atau other issue yang dapat ditindaklanjuti.
tickets.scope: Implement feedback API/UI, category/details, optional citation/claim, revision links, dedupe/rate limit.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: All categories available; feedback pins answer/trace revisions; update policy enforced; visible to dashboard; abuse limits applied.
tickets.test_evidence: API/component tests; revision-link assertion; rate-limit test.

tickets.title: Expose Retrieval Inspector trace API
tickets.user_story: Sebagai developer, saya mengambil planner, lanes, filters, scores, selections, exclusions, assessment, dan context dari satu authorized endpoint.
tickets.scope: Create trace DTO/query endpoints dengan pagination, candidate detail, revision links, redaction, schema version.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: All lanes/reasons included; unauthorized candidates never leak; completed trace immutable; large lists paginated; schema documented.
tickets.test_evidence: API contract; permission/redaction; large-trace performance.

tickets.title: Build Inspector planner, lane, filter and score views
tickets.user_story: Sebagai developer, saya mendiagnosis query tanpa raw server logs.
tickets.scope: Build query/plan summary, lane tables, filters, raw scores/ranks, RRF view, search/filter, source/unit panels.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: All lanes visible; selected/excluded clear; filters/revisions shown; empty/failed lane reason visible; deep links work.
tickets.test_evidence: Playwright fixtures; visual regression; accessible tables.

tickets.title: Visualize reranking, expansion, exclusions and final context replay
tickets.user_story: Sebagai developer, saya memahami mengapa candidate dipilih/dibuang dan context yang dikirim.
tickets.scope: Add rerank comparison, dedupe/diversity reasons, expansion view, token zones, context text, pinned replay.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Final order/budget visible; every added/excluded item has reason; replay pinned; differences flagged; access enforced.
tickets.test_evidence: Inspector E2E replay; reason-code coverage; context snapshot.

tickets.title: Build model/provider configuration with secret references
tickets.user_story: Sebagai operator, saya mengelola endpoint/model/routing tanpa raw secret atau redeploy code.
tickets.scope: Implement versioned config CRUD, external secret refs, validation/test connection, aliases, role-gated UI, rollback.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Raw secret absent; invalid config cannot promote; test result audited; alias changes routing; rollback available.
tickets.test_evidence: Secret scan; promotion/rollback E2E; permission test.

tickets.title: Implement prompt versioning, review and promotion
tickets.user_story: Sebagai AI operator, saya membuat prompt revision, membandingkan diff, dan mempromosikannya audit-able.
tickets.scope: Build prompt/version CRUD, variable validation, diff, staging/prod aliases, reason/approver, rollback.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Promoted prompt immutable; required variables validated; generation pins version; unauthorized promote denied; rollback audited.
tickets.test_evidence: Prompt lifecycle E2E; missing-variable; trace pin.

tickets.title: Implement feature flags and safe rollout controls
tickets.user_story: Sebagai operator, saya merilis retrieval/model/UI changes bertahap dan dapat mematikan cepat.
tickets.scope: Implement versioned flags, tenant/user percentage targeting, deterministic bucketing, kill switch, resolver, audit, rollback.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Same subject deterministic; kill switch immediate; invalid targeting rejected; effective flags stored in trace; changes audited.
tickets.test_evidence: Bucketing property tests; kill-switch integration; trace assertion.

tickets.title: Build unified operational status and failure taxonomy
tickets.user_story: Sebagai operator, saya membedakan ingestion, indexing, retrieval, provider, dan validation failure serta menavigasi ke record terkait.
tickets.scope: Define component/failure codes, health/event ingestion, status APIs, panels, filters, trace/job/release links, degraded guidance.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Failure has primary subsystem/reason; outage distinct from data failure; stale health marked; drill-down works; scopes enforced.
tickets.test_evidence: Failure-injection matrix; dashboard E2E; count reconciliation; runbook links.

tickets.title: Create versioned evaluation-set and case model
tickets.user_story: Sebagai evaluator, saya menyimpan cases untuk exact lookup, retrieval, grounded generation, false premise, abstention, dan sensitive scenarios.
tickets.scope: Implement set/version, case type/language/risk, query/conversation, expected source/span/claims/behavior, owner/reviewer.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Every case has owner/expected evidence or behavior; published set immutable; required categories representable; source refs pin revisions.
tickets.test_evidence: Schema/API tests; samples per category; immutability.

tickets.title: Implement evaluation import/export, versioning and launch seed suite
tickets.user_story: Sebagai quality team, saya mengelola benchmark dan memiliki seed suite untuk semua release gates.
tickets.scope: Build JSON/CSV import/export, validation, new-version diff, sensitive labels, ownership, seed cases mapped to gate metrics.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Round-trip preserves cases/evidence; invalid refs rejected; edits create version; seed covers six required categories and gate metrics.
tickets.test_evidence: Round-trip tests; seed coverage report; ref validation.

tickets.title: Implement retrieval-only evaluation runner and metrics
tickets.user_story: Sebagai retrieval engineer, saya mengukur exact lookup, Recall@K, MRR/nDCG, source/span, scope, dan latency tanpa generation noise.
tickets.scope: Run pinned planner/index over set version; store candidates, metrics, errors, reports.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Run pins versions; no generation invoked; expected matching deterministic; aggregate/per-case stored; scope leak critical.
tickets.test_evidence: Seed run; metric unit tests; reproducibility rerun.

tickets.title: Implement end-to-end evaluation runner and failure taxonomy
tickets.user_story: Sebagai quality team, saya mengevaluasi full answer sambil memisahkan retrieval, generation, citation, attribution, dan policy failures.
tickets.scope: Run pinned pipeline; store answer/trace/validator outputs; calculate metrics; classify root stage.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Run pins all revisions/config; errors separated; sensitive behavior scored; trace replay available; provider failures distinct.
tickets.test_evidence: Seed E2E; injected-stage failures; reproducibility report.

tickets.title: Compare knowledge/index/prompt/model revisions on identical cases
tickets.user_story: Sebagai release reviewer, saya membandingkan dua revision stacks pada case version sama dan melihat improved/regressed/unchanged.
tickets.scope: Build paired-run validation, metric deltas, case classification, filters, UI/export.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Reject differing case versions unless mapped; display both manifests; outcomes deterministic; link both traces/evidence.
tickets.test_evidence: Known-delta fixture; mismatch rejection; comparison UI E2E.

tickets.title: Implement deterministic release gate policies and stored results
tickets.user_story: Sebagai release manager, critical thresholds dievaluasi oleh policy versioned, bukan keputusan manual tak tercatat.
tickets.scope: Implement policies for exact lookup, recall, citations/quotes, unsupported claims, attribution, sensitive behavior, traceability; hash inputs/results.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Same inputs same result; thresholds/sources stored; missing metric fails closed; override requires role/reason/audit if policy allows.
tickets.test_evidence: Boundary tests; deterministic hash; unauthorized override.

tickets.title: Block knowledge/index/config promotion on failed critical gates
tickets.user_story: Sebagai organization, production promotion tidak terjadi ketika critical regression threshold gagal.
tickets.scope: Integrate gate checks ke knowledge/index/config alias promotion, store artifact, expose failure reasons, test rollback/races.
tickets.acceptance_criteria: Failed/missing critical gate blocks alias update; passed gate pins stack; result visible/audited; rollback to prior passed release works.
tickets.test_evidence: E2E blocked/passed promotion; race test; artifact inspection.

traceability.requirement: Support Indonesian, Arabic, and mixed Indonesian-Arabic queries.
traceability.prd_acceptance: Language is preserved unless the user explicitly requests translation.

traceability.requirement: Render answer summary, evidence, differences of opinion, conditions/exceptions, limitations, and evidence-status.
traceability.prd_acceptance: No synthetic numeric confidence percentage is shown.

traceability.requirement: Show source cards with title, author, edition, page/section, verification state, and exact quoted span.
traceability.prd_acceptance: A user can open the exact source location from every citation.

traceability.requirement: Keep follow-up questions grounded in the conversation while refreshing retrieval for every factual turn.
traceability.prd_acceptance: Conversation memory never replaces fresh source retrieval for factual claims.

traceability.requirement: Allow feedback: helpful, citation issue, doctrinal issue, translation issue, or other.
traceability.prd_acceptance: Feedback is attached to answer, retrieval, knowledge, and index revisions for triage.

traceability.requirement: Maintain versioned evaluation sets for exact lookup, retrieval, grounded generation, false premises, abstention, and sensitive cases.
traceability.prd_acceptance: Every case has expected evidence or expected behavior and reviewer ownership.

traceability.requirement: Run retrieval-only and end-to-end evaluations independently.
traceability.prd_acceptance: A regression report separates source/index/retrieval errors from model-generation and validation errors.

traceability.requirement: Compare two knowledge, index, prompt, or model revision stacks on the same cases.
traceability.prd_acceptance: Report highlights improved, regressed, and unchanged examples with trace links.

traceability.requirement: Block production promotion on critical regression thresholds.
traceability.prd_acceptance: The release gate is deterministic, versioned, and stored with the promoted or rejected release.

traceability.requirement: Compile source spans and published knowledge revisions into versioned retrieval units.
traceability.prd_acceptance: Each unit records `source_revision_id` and/or `knowledge_revision_id`, parent ID, language, topic, madhhab, authority, and access scope.

traceability.requirement: Perform incremental indexing from source-processing events and published knowledge-release diffs.
traceability.prd_acceptance: Unchanged units retain logical IDs and embeddings; only changed dependencies are recomputed.

traceability.requirement: Maintain lexical, vector, metadata, and relationship indexes as disposable derived artifacts.
traceability.prd_acceptance: A clean rebuild from canonical object storage and PostgreSQL records produces an equivalent logical index release.

traceability.requirement: Support staging and production index aliases.
traceability.prd_acceptance: A release is promoted atomically only after its validation suite passes.

traceability.requirement: Record embedding model/version, vector dimensions, normalization profile, compiler version, and index configuration.
traceability.prd_acceptance: Every retrieval trace identifies the exact index release and configuration.

traceability.requirement: Store curated knowledge as typed, revisioned PostgreSQL records with Markdown body content and structured metadata.
traceability.prd_acceptance: Every revision has a stable concept ID, revision ID, content hash, author, timestamps, type, topic, publication state, and access scope.

traceability.requirement: Expose a form-based Knowledge Studio; editors do not need to edit SQL, YAML, or repository files.
traceability.prd_acceptance: Saving a draft creates an immutable concept revision inside a database-backed changeset.

traceability.requirement: Support concept types: definition, fiqh position, evidence, rule, exception, comparison, glossary term, source note, and policy.
traceability.prd_acceptance: Each type has documented required fields, validation rules, and a dedicated UI form profile.

traceability.requirement: Track provenance, generation method, human verification, status, staleness, source revision, and reviewer notes.
traceability.prd_acceptance: Published records expose who verified them, when, and against which exact source revisions and spans.

traceability.requirement: Support typed links between concepts and exact source spans.
traceability.prd_acceptance: Missing targets, invalid relationship types, and cross-scope links block publication.

traceability.requirement: Use database-backed revisions, reviewable diffs, immutable release manifests, active aliases, and rollback.
traceability.prd_acceptance: Production can return to a previous knowledge release through an atomic alias change without deleting later revisions.

traceability.requirement: Provide a model-agnostic gateway for local and frontier providers.
traceability.prd_acceptance: A provider can change through configuration without changing retrieval or answer storage schemas.

traceability.requirement: Require structured answer output with material claim-to-evidence mappings.
traceability.prd_acceptance: Invalid output is repaired once or rejected before being shown.

traceability.requirement: Separate direct source statements, synthesis, differences of opinion, conditions/exceptions, limitations, and follow-up questions.
traceability.prd_acceptance: UI can render each section independently and cite it accurately.

traceability.requirement: Classify language, intent, risk, requested madhhab/scope, and whether the query is exact lookup, standard QA, comparison, calculation, or research.
traceability.prd_acceptance: Planner returns a structured plan stored in the retrieval trace.

traceability.requirement: Run exact identifier and quotation lookup before semantic retrieval when applicable.
traceability.prd_acceptance: Ayah/hadith/source identifiers and exact Arabic phrases do not rely only on embeddings.

traceability.requirement: Run hybrid retrieval using PostgreSQL full-text/trigram ranking and semantic vectors, followed by rank fusion.
traceability.prd_acceptance: Both candidate sets, raw ranks, and fusion scores are visible in Retrieval Inspector.

traceability.requirement: Apply publication, metadata, tenant, and access filters before evidence reaches reranking or the model.
traceability.prd_acceptance: Evidence outside the caller's scope never appears in candidates, caches, inspection results, context, or model requests.

traceability.requirement: Rerank, deduplicate, diversify sources, and expand parent sections, adjacent spans, footnotes, and relevant concept links.
traceability.prd_acceptance: Final evidence preserves complete conditions and exceptions instead of isolated fragments.

traceability.requirement: Estimate evidence sufficiency and abstain or escalate when coverage is weak, missing, or contradictory.
traceability.prd_acceptance: Low-sufficiency cases are not presented as definitive rulings.

traceability.requirement: Assemble context adaptively rather than sending the provider maximum by default.
traceability.prd_acceptance: Context profile, selected evidence order, truncation decisions, and token budget are logged for every answer.

traceability.requirement: Create an immutable source record before processing any file. Required metadata: title, author, source type, language, edition, publisher, rights status, owner, tenant, and access scope.
traceability.prd_acceptance: A source receives a stable `source_id`; every file revision has a content hash; original bytes cannot be silently overwritten.

traceability.requirement: Support PDF, scanned PDF, EPUB, HTML, Markdown, TXT, and structured JSON/CSV imports through pluggable processors.
traceability.prd_acceptance: Each import produces a versioned processing manifest with page/section boundaries, processor version, warnings, and failures.

traceability.requirement: Preserve source-to-text traceability at page, section, and span level.
traceability.prd_acceptance: Every extracted passage can open the exact location of its source revision.

traceability.requirement: Provide OCR review for scanned Arabic and Indonesian documents.
traceability.prd_acceptance: Reviewer can compare page image and extracted text, edit the text, and retain raw and prior corrected OCR revisions.

traceability.requirement: Allow a source revision to be deprecated without deleting historical answer traces.
traceability.prd_acceptance: Old answers continue to resolve the exact source revision used at generation time.

traceability.requirement: Dashboard source health, unpublished changes, stale concepts, broken links, failed jobs, and open feedback.
traceability.prd_acceptance: Each card drills into actionable, permission-scoped records.

traceability.requirement: Provide a side-by-side source viewer and concept editor with exact span selection.
traceability.prd_acceptance: Selecting text creates a stable source-span reference pinned to a source revision.

traceability.requirement: Support changeset states: draft, submitted, changes requested, approved, published, rejected, and rolled back.
traceability.prd_acceptance: Only authorized reviewers can approve publication; invalid transitions are rejected.

traceability.requirement: Retrieval Inspector shows planner output, every candidate lane, filters, scores, reranking, exclusions, evidence assessment, and final context.
traceability.prd_acceptance: A developer can diagnose a failed query without reading raw server logs.

traceability.requirement: Provide model/provider configuration, prompt versioning, feature flags, and safe rollout controls.
traceability.prd_acceptance: Configuration changes are audited, versioned, permission-controlled, and rollbackable.

traceability.requirement: Expose operational status for ingestion, indexing, retrieval, model calls, and validation.
traceability.prd_acceptance: Operators can distinguish provider failure from source, index, retrieval, or validation failure.

traceability.requirement: Validate that cited source IDs, revisions, pages, sections, and spans exist.
traceability.prd_acceptance: No broken citation can be published to the user.

traceability.requirement: Verify exact quotations against canonical source text.
traceability.prd_acceptance: A quotation mismatch triggers repair, conversion to paraphrase, or removal.

traceability.requirement: Detect unsupported material claims and incorrect madhhab attribution.
traceability.prd_acceptance: A critical validation failure causes one repair attempt, then abstention.

traceability.requirement: Store a complete answer trace: query plan, evidence IDs, source/knowledge/index release, context manifest, prompt version, model/provider, token usage, and validation results.
traceability.prd_acceptance: An authorized reviewer can reconstruct the evidence pack for any answer.
